input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by us. The commercial model in paragraph 5 is a revenue share under which Kubient collects from Advertisers and remits our share, so there are no committed fees we could be charged on termination. The only termination-related money provision (paragraph 4(a)) entitles Kubient to fees actually generated during the 90-day notice period — that is earned revenue share for services actually rendered, not a pre-agreed damages or penalty amount, and it does not apply where we terminate for material breach. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is warranted. We note only that the exhibits are not before us; if any Exhibit introduces a minimum or early-termination fee, it should be capped at three months' fees as the sole liquidated amount.
